webhook-clone.name: Webhook Clone
webhook-clone.description: Clone the repository when a webhook push event is received

config.webhookStatusNotConfiguredDescription: The webhook is not yet set up. Click the button to configure it manually.
config.webhookBranchFilterDescription: Only trigger builds for matching branches — the pushed branch for a push, the destination branch for a merge request. Supports comma-separated values and wildcards (e.g. feature/*). Leave empty to accept all branches.
config.webhookTriggerEventsDescription: Git events that start a build. Re-run the webhook setup after enabling new events so the provider sends them.
config.webhookMergeRequestActionsDescription: Merge request states that start a build. Merge requests coming from a fork are ignored.
config.webhookTagFilterDescription: Comma-separated tag names. A trailing * matches a prefix. Leave empty to accept every tag.
